about.title: Sources and licence
about.lead: Meshes and CT on the temporal-bone page are the OpenEar ZETA right temporal bone. The notes have not been reviewed.
about.openearBody: Human temporal-bone models published by Sieber et al. in Scientific Data (2018). The paper and the Zenodo data are CC BY 4.0.
about.obligation1: Credit Sieber et al., the OpenEar library, Sci Data 2018.
about.obligation2: Say what changed. The bone and the sigmoid/dura surface are simplified. The other structures keep their vertex counts.
about.obligation3: Keep the CC BY 4.0 name and link.
about.sampleBody: The models are Draco-compressed OpenEar surfaces, turned into the upright head. The cochlear scala, vestibule, and three semicircular canals are separate. The facial nerve on this surface runs from the fundus to the stylomastoid region; its internal-canal part travels in the cochleovestibular bundle. CT is a 0.25 mm webp stack. The jugular bulb is a landmark only. The sinus and dura share one surface.
about.upperBody: The entry skull, mandible, cervical vertebrae, clavicles, and right auricle are a simplified extract of the Z-Anatomy Blender template (CC BY-SA 4.0; BodyParts3D, CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan). Checked 2026-11-21. Skin is the MakeHuman hm08 base, released as CC0 1.0 in September 2020 by Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, and Jonas Hauquier (makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj; LICENSE.ASSETS.md). It is cropped to the head, neck, and shoulders. The head stays upright. The temporal bone is turned into that head at scale 1, with the bony canal behind the concha. The two specimens differ, so the mastoid tips do not coincide. The fit is unverified. Residuals are on ?dev=1. Atlas shading is procedural and is not a copy of a textbook plate.
about.vorBody: Z-Anatomy assets planned for the VOR route are CC BY-SA. Derivatives that include them must stay under the same terms, with attribution kept separate from OpenEar (CC BY).
about.reviewBody: A dot in front of a sentence means it has not been checked. YS 검수 완료 means the review is done. After a geometry change the copy goes back to 미검증.
about.jugular: 경정맥구 is the jugular bulb. 목정맥공 is the jugular foramen. This model is missing the bulb.
